capabilities: Define which files count as index files via naming patterns
Check index files for links to all files in their folders
Add missing links to the index or a dedicated file
Mark files with missing links in the file explorer
Support Canvas files as index files
disambiguation: Not a search-index tool; it checks that MOC index notes contain links to the files in their folders.
motivation: The author found existing index-maintenance plugins too rigid, enforcing a fixed structure, and wanted a flexible checker that leaves each index's layout to the user.
problem: Obsidian gives no way to verify that index (MOC) files actually link every file they are supposed to cover, so files can get lost outside the index.
summary: Link checker for MOC index files that verifies index notes and Canvas files contain links to all files they should, and adds missing ones.
